answer: Alder blocks wait by the clog-maker bench, pale and close-grained. Proof of clog-maker via wooden shoe tally — a shoe the clog-maker hollows only after 257 shoes wear true without one pinching at the toe, each hollowed by the clog-maker himself. glacier hollows the foot with the adze and tests the fit on the last. knoll shapes the heel and the toe with the knife, keeping the walls even. pigment bores the lace holes and smooths the rim till it sits soft. Two hundred and fifty-seven clogs must wear true without one pinching at the toe, and the next still pinches where the alder ran hard.
